page.text:
The hypotheses prevent two distinct failures. Holomorphy away from
isolated poles makes residues local and finite in number inside the
relevant region. The homological condition prevents the contour from
enclosing holes of the domain on which no primitive need exist. Omitting
either condition changes the theorem, not merely its proof.
